_comment: Mutation survivors accepted as a baseline for the core sweep. The nightly ratchet fails when a survivor appears outside this set, and when an entry is no longer a survivor. Regenerate with `python scripts/mutation_gate.py --baseline core --update` after a sweep, and only ever let this set shrink. Entries are the survivor line without its line:col position, so they survive unrelated code motion.

_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision.rs: re: `Kind::NoneType`'s region is `1 << 0`, and `1 >> 0` is the same value. A genuinely equivalent mutant, and the only one of the seven shift constants that is: the other six are killed by `every_kind_lands_in_the_partition_and_the_scalars_land_apart`, which requires each scalar kind's region to be non-empty and pairwise disjoint and every container kind to share the one that is left.
The arm joins the guards of two edges that reach one block, which makes a signature finer; deleting it falls through to the arm that reads the pair as the else edge, which makes every such signature coarser. A coarser signature can only merge more states, so the mutant is caught only by a language where the extra merge is wrong -- two states reaching one block by different letters. `merge_targets` runs first and leaves one edge per target, so the arm is reached only where a block holds two distinct but equivalent targets, and in that case both states are separated anyway by the blocks their other letters reach. Three witnesses were written for it, the sharpest reaching the block through separate equivalent targets after three letters, and the mutant survives all three. The arm stays because the refinement is what makes the partition the coarsest correct one rather than merely a correct one.
